title: 子代理与代理技能：面向长周期代理任务的可复用知识执行
summary: 论文研究如何让语言模型代理利用可复用知识库解决长周期任务。对比两种方式：将技能指令加载到主上下文（代理技能），或将技能包作为子代理调用（子代理执行）。实验表明，当技能包具有清晰输入输出契约时，子代理执行优于代理技能执行，但需额外通信开销。
summary_en: This paper investigates how LLM agents can leverage libraries of reusable knowledge for long-horizon tasks. It compares agent-skill execution (loading skill instructions into the main context) with subagent execution (invoking skill packages as subagents with fresh context windows). Results show subagent execution outperforms agent-skill execution when skill packages expose clear input-output contracts, at the cost of extra communication overhead.
